```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-patients-exposed
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# The dataset table arrives long, one row per factor and measure; the table
# gives each measure its own columns over the eight factors.
# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): never let this read fail. A stored
# reference dataset outlives every release, and one saved before the table
# existed has no slot to read, so the no-data note stands where the table
# cannot be built.
if (!is.null(benchmark_data$patients_exposed_table)) {

  pe_data <- benchmark_data$patients_exposed_table
  # The benchmark join suffixes each dataset's columns before joining, so the
  # merged table carries n_own, pooled_ref, q1_ref and friends; the pivot
  # appends the measure to those names.
  has_reference <- "pooled_ref" %in% names(pe_data)

  pe_wide <- pe_data |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = "factor",
      names_from = "measure",
      values_from = -c("factor", "measure"),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{measure}") |>
    dplyr::select(-tidyselect::starts_with("quartile_departments")) |>
    # The mean days come without intervals: the dataset carries none for the
    # mean, whose bootstrap would count a department's exposed patients as
    # independent of one another.
    dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(as.vector(outer(
      c("ci_lower_", "ci_upper_", paste0(rep(c("q1_", "q2_", "q3_"), each = 2),
                                         rep(c("ci_lower_", "ci_upper_"), 3))),
      c("own", "ref"), function(ci, ds) paste0(ci, ds, "_mean_days"))))) |>
    dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(c(
      "n_ref_patients_exposed", "n_ref_mean_days")))

  own_ci_cols <- c(
    "ci_lower_own_patients_exposed", "ci_upper_own_patients_exposed")

  tbl_data <- pe_wide |>
    dplyr::rename(
      count_exp = "n_own_patients_exposed",
      rate_exp = "pooled_own_patients_exposed",
      ci_lower_rate_exp = "ci_lower_own_patients_exposed",
      ci_upper_rate_exp = "ci_upper_own_patients_exposed",
      count_days = "n_own_mean_days",
      rate_days = "pooled_own_mean_days")

  if (has_reference) {
    tbl_data <- tbl_data |>
      dplyr::rename(
        pooled_exp = "pooled_ref_patients_exposed",
        ci_lower_pooled_exp = "ci_lower_ref_patients_exposed",
        ci_upper_pooled_exp = "ci_upper_ref_patients_exposed",
        q1_exp = "q1_ref_patients_exposed",
        q2_exp = "q2_ref_patients_exposed",
        q3_exp = "q3_ref_patients_exposed",
        q1_ci_lower_exp = "q1_ci_lower_ref_patients_exposed",
        q1_ci_upper_exp = "q1_ci_upper_ref_patients_exposed",
        q2_ci_lower_exp = "q2_ci_lower_ref_patients_exposed",
        q2_ci_upper_exp = "q2_ci_upper_ref_patients_exposed",
        q3_ci_lower_exp = "q3_ci_lower_ref_patients_exposed",
        q3_ci_upper_exp = "q3_ci_upper_ref_patients_exposed",
        pooled_days = "pooled_ref_mean_days",
        q1_days = "q1_ref_mean_days",
        q2_days = "q2_ref_mean_days",
        q3_days = "q3_ref_mean_days")
  }

  cols_to_drop <- character(0)
  if (!include_rate_ci) cols_to_drop <- c(cols_to_drop, own_ci_cols)
  if (!has_reference || !include_pooled_ci)
    cols_to_drop <- c(cols_to_drop,
      "ci_lower_pooled_exp", "ci_upper_pooled_exp")
  if (!has_reference || !include_quartile_ci)
    cols_to_drop <- c(cols_to_drop, as.vector(outer(
      paste0(rep(c("q1_", "q2_", "q3_"), each = 2),
             rep(c("ci_lower_", "ci_upper_"), 3)),
      "exp", paste0)))
  cols_to_drop <- cols_to_drop[cols_to_drop %in% names(tbl_data)]
  if (length(cols_to_drop) > 0)
    tbl_data <- tbl_data |> dplyr::select(-tidyselect::all_of(cols_to_drop))

  ci_pattern <- ci_pattern_inline

  tbl <- tbl_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      factor = dplyr::recode_values(
        as.character(.data$factor),
        "cvc" ~ sR$cvc,
        "pvc" ~ sR$pvc,
        "inv" ~ sR$inv,
        "niv" ~ sR$niv,
        "ab" ~ sR$`tbl-risk-density-rates`$any_antibiotic,
        "human_milk" ~ sR$human_milk_sc,
        "probiotic" ~ sR$probiotics_sc,
        "kangaroo_care" ~ sR$kangaroo_care_sc)) |>
    gt(rowname_col = "factor") |>
    sub_missing() |>
    gt::tab_options(
      latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
      table.width = pct(100),
      table.font.size = if (has_reference) 8 else 10,
      footnotes.marks = "extended"
    ) |>
    # Every value column but the counts, the interval bounds included: the
    # merges below splice what these formats print, so an unformatted bound
    # would reach the cell at full precision and the wrong decimal mark.
    fmt_number(
      columns = !tidyselect::any_of(c("count_exp", "count_days")),
      decimals = 1,
      sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
      min_sep_threshold = 2,
      locale = locale_gt) |>
    fmt_integer(
      columns = tidyselect::all_of(c("count_exp", "count_days")),
      sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
      min_sep_threshold = 2)

  # Only the columns the table carries get labels: without reference data the
  # reference columns are absent, and gt refuses to label one of them.
  labels <- c(
    count_exp = sR$table_headers$count,
    rate_exp = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$percent,
    pooled_exp = sR$table_headers$pooled,
    q1_exp = sR$table_headers$q1,
    q2_exp = sR$table_headers$q2,
    q3_exp = sR$table_headers$q3,
    count_days = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$total_days,
    rate_days = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$mean,
    pooled_days = sR$table_headers$pooled,
    q1_days = sR$table_headers$q1,
    q2_days = sR$table_headers$q2,
    q3_days = sR$table_headers$q3)
  labels <- labels[names(labels) %in% names(tbl_data)]

  tbl <- tbl |>
    cols_label(!!!labels) |>
    tab_spanner(
      label = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$patients_exposed,
      columns = tidyselect::any_of(c(
        "count_exp", "rate_exp", "pooled_exp", "q1_exp", "q2_exp", "q3_exp")),
      id = "span_exposed") |>
    tab_spanner(
      label = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$mean_days,
      columns = tidyselect::any_of(c(
        "count_days", "rate_days", "pooled_days", "q1_days", "q2_days",
        "q3_days")),
      id = "span_days") |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = list(
        cells_column_spanners(),
        cells_column_labels(),
        cells_row_groups()
      )
    )

  if (include_rate_ci && "ci_lower_rate_exp" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(rate_exp, ci_lower_rate_exp, ci_upper_rate_exp),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = !is.na(tbl_data$rate_exp))
  }
  if (has_reference && include_pooled_ci &&
      "ci_lower_pooled_exp" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(pooled_exp, ci_lower_pooled_exp, ci_upper_pooled_exp),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_exp))
  }
  if (has_reference && include_quartile_ci &&
      "q1_ci_lower_exp" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    has_boot <- !is.na(tbl$`_data`[["q1_ci_lower_exp"]])
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(columns = c(q1_exp, q1_ci_lower_exp, q1_ci_upper_exp),
                     pattern = ci_pattern, rows = has_boot) |>
      gt::cols_merge(columns = c(q2_exp, q2_ci_lower_exp, q2_ci_upper_exp),
                     pattern = ci_pattern, rows = has_boot) |>
      gt::cols_merge(columns = c(q3_exp, q3_ci_lower_exp, q3_ci_upper_exp),
                     pattern = ci_pattern, rows = has_boot)
  }

  tbl <- tbl |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$abbreviations_footnote,
      locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "span_exposed"),
      placement = "right")

  if (has_reference) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      cols_width(
        stub() ~ pct(16),
        count_exp ~ pct(6), rate_exp ~ pct(10), pooled_exp ~ pct(10),
        q1_exp ~ pct(4), q2_exp ~ pct(4), q3_exp ~ pct(4),
        count_days ~ pct(6), rate_days ~ pct(10), pooled_days ~ pct(10),
        q1_days ~ pct(4), q2_days ~ pct(4), q3_days ~ pct(4))
  } else {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      cols_width(
        stub() ~ pct(30),
        count_exp ~ pct(12), rate_exp ~ pct(16),
        count_days ~ pct(12), rate_days ~ pct(16))
  }

  if (any(!is.na(tbl_data$rate_exp) & tbl_data$count_exp < sparse_threshold,
          na.rm = TRUE)) {
    sparse_note <- interpolate_translation(
      if (include_rate_ci) sR$sparse_data_footnote
      else sR$sparse_data_footnote_no_ci,
      threshold = sparse_threshold)
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::tab_footnote(
        footnote = sparse_note,
        locations = cells_body(
          columns = count_exp,
          rows = !is.na(tbl_data$rate_exp) &
            tbl_data$count_exp < sparse_threshold),
        placement = "right")
  }

  tbl
} else {
  no_data_table(sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$no_data)
}
```
